name: qrstream
description: Air-gapped file transfer over animated QR codes: fountain code + optional RGB 3-channel, offline PWA receiver/sender and a userscript sender.

scripts.test:unit: node test/unit/decoder.js && node test/unit/overhead.js && node test/unit/rgb-capture.js && node test/unit/grid.js && node test/unit/compress.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node test/e2e/transfer.js && node test/e2e/grid.js && node test/e2e/offline.js && node test/e2e/fallback.js && node test/e2e/userscript.js
